source: Patterns from github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop, adapted for CVs, LinkedIn notes and cold emails.
why: Recruiters now read dozens of obviously AI-written messages a day, so slop is worse than plain writing — it signals that no thought went in. These checks run as regex before any model call, so they are deterministic, free, and cannot themselves hallucinate.

patterns.label: "It's not X, it's Y" construction
patterns.fix: State the thing you actually mean, once.

patterns.label: Throat-clearing opener
patterns.regex: \b(?:here'?s the thing|let me be clear|let'?s be honest|make no mistake|here'?s what(?:'?s| is) (?:interesting|wild|surprising)|the truth is)\b
patterns.fix: Delete it and start with the point.

patterns.label: Faux-insight setup
patterns.regex: \b(?:what (?:nobody|no one|few people) (?:tells you|talks about|realizes|realises)|the part (?:everyone|most people) miss(?:es)?|here'?s what (?:nobody|no one) says)\b
patterns.fix: If the insight is real, just say it. If it isn't, cut it.

patterns.label: Importance puffery
patterns.regex: \b(?:a testament to|marks? a (?:pivotal|defining|watershed) (?:moment|point)|speaks? volumes|underscor(?:es|ing) the importance|highlight(?:s|ing) (?:the|their|its) commitment|stands? as a)\b
patterns.fix: Replace with the concrete fact that made you want to say this.

patterns.label: Fake-profound ending
patterns.regex: \b(?:the future (?:isn'?t|is not) coming[.,]? it'?s (?:already )?here|and that changes everything|the rest is history|that'?s the (?:whole|entire) (?:point|thing|story))\b
patterns.fix: End on your actual ask instead.

patterns.label: Dramatic one-word fragment
patterns.fix: Fold it into the sentence before.

patterns.label: Weasel attribution
patterns.fix: Name the source or drop the claim.

patterns.label: Colon reveal
patterns.regex: \b(?:the (?:best|worst|real|hard) part|the result|the kicker|the catch|the problem|my favou?rite part)\s*:

patterns.label: Telltale AI vocabulary
patterns.regex: \b(?:delve into|navigat(?:e|ing) the (?:complexities|landscape|world)|in today'?s (?:fast-paced|ever-evolving|digital) (?:world|landscape|environment)|unlock(?:ing)? (?:the )?(?:potential|power)|harness(?:ing)? the power|embark on|tapestry|realm of|plethora|myriad of|seamless(?:ly)? integrat|robust solution|cutting-edge|game-?changer|treasure trove)\b
patterns.fix: Use the plain word you would say out loud.

patterns.label: Buzzword stacking with no content
patterns.regex: \b(?:results?-(?:driven|oriented)|detail-oriented|self-motivated|dynamic professional|team player|hard-?working|go-?getter|think outside the box|synerg(?:y|ies|istic)|value[- ]add|passionate about (?:excellence|innovation))\b
patterns.fix: Delete. Replace the space with a quantified achievement — claiming 'detail-oriented' persuades nobody, shipping a 0-defect migration does.

patterns.label: Duty statement instead of achievement
patterns.fix: Start with a past-tense action verb and end with the outcome.

patterns.label: Unquantified intensifier
patterns.fix: Put the number in. "Significantly reduced" means nothing; "cut 38%" does.

patterns.label: Generic outreach flattery
patterns.regex: \b(?:I(?:'?m| am) (?:so )?(?:incredibly |truly |really )?(?:excited|thrilled|passionate) (?:about|to)|I(?:'?ve| have) (?:long )?(?:admired|been following) (?:your|the) (?:work|company|journey)|(?:huge|big) fan of what you(?:'?re| are) building|your company(?:'?s)? mission (?:really )?resonates)\b
patterns.fix: Name one specific thing — a product decision, a launch, a post — and why it is relevant to you.

patterns.label: Filler email opener
patterns.regex: \b(?:I hope this (?:email|message) finds you well|hope you(?:'?re| are) doing well|hope all is well|trust you are doing well)\b
patterns.fix: Open with why you are writing. Recruiters skim the first line only.

patterns.label: "Reaching out" boilerplate
patterns.regex: \b(?:I(?:'?m| am) reaching out (?:to you )?(?:because|as|regarding|to)|just wanted to reach out|wanted to touch base|circling back|following up on my previous)\b
patterns.fix: Say the thing directly: "I applied for X" or "I'd like to ask about X".

patterns.label: Asserting fit instead of showing it
patterns.regex: \b(?:I (?:would|'?d) be (?:a )?(?:great|perfect|strong|excellent) fit|I believe I (?:would be|am) (?:the )?(?:ideal|perfect|right)|my (?:skills|background) (?:align|make me) (?:perfectly )?(?:with|a))\b
patterns.fix: Show one piece of evidence that makes the fit obvious and let them conclude it.

patterns.label: Em-dash pile-up
patterns.fix: Keep one em-dash per paragraph at most.

patterns.label: Reflexive rule-of-three adjectives
patterns.fix: Pick the one that is true and drop the other two.

structural_checks.label: Bullet longer than two lines
structural_checks.fix: Split it, or cut to the outcome.

structural_checks.label: Same opening verb across bullets
structural_checks.fix: Vary the verb — a screener notices the repetition before the content.

structural_checks.label: LinkedIn connection note over the limit
structural_checks.fix: LinkedIn truncates connection notes at 300 characters. Cut to one specific reason plus the ask.

structural_checks.label: Cold email over 150 words
structural_checks.fix: Hiring managers read the first three lines. Anything past 150 words is unread.
